lines.en: - I'm Spencer. - I'm Maeve.
I am a Harper's cousin that was kidnapped and taken to sea.
- Oh. - That's a nice image.
- Oh! - Oh, gee! Oh, my dear.
I, uh...
I guess I haven't gotten my land legs yet.
Well, lucky for me, I got to catch you.
Check it out. I accidentally Googled myself.
Wow, super famous sculptor, and look at that net worth.
I'm sorry, do I know you?
Or you?
I told Spencer how much I was missing the ocean,
and he surprised me with my favorite dinner.
An Alaskan crab leg buffet.
Well, it's my turn to shower.
Hopefully, you left me some strands of hair stuck to the wall.
Mwah!
Without a doubt,
the biggest red flag I have ever seen.
That's a red flag, do you know what I mean?
